BETA Close X Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC reports that between August 10th and August 14th, 2026, it repurchased a total of 575,351 ordinary shares as part of its $250 million share repurchase program. The company intends to cancel these shares, and following these transactions, the total number of issued ordinary shares will be 209,008,632, with the total voting rights remaining the same. Disclaimer* Hikma Pharmaceuticals Plc 17 August 2026 HIKMA PHARMACEUTICALS PLC TRANSACTIONS IN OWN SHARES Hikma Pharmaceuticals PLC (LSE: HIK) (NasdaqDubai: HIK) (LEI: 549300BNS685UXH4JI75) (the '' Company '') announces that, during the period from 10 August 2026 to 14 August 2026 (inclusive) (the '' Disclosure Period ''), it purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each through J.P. Morgan Securities plc as part of the second tranche (which commenced on 27 May 2026) of its $250 million share repurchase programme announced on 26 February 2026 (the '' Buyback Programme ''). Since the launch of the Buyback Programme on 26 February 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 12,877,821 ordinary shares at a total cost of £181,983,240.92. The Company holds 12,833,233 of its ordinary shares in treasury. Following the settlement of the above transactions and cancellation of the repurchased shares, the Company will have 209,008,632 ordinary shares in issue (excluding treasury shares) and the total number of voting rights in the Company will therefore be 209,008,632.
